title: Update a dropdown from another field
description: Change available Admin UI options immediately when an editor changes a related field.
problem: The valid options for one field depend on what the editor picked in another field.
summary: Update select options from sibling field data so the next choice stays constrained by the current form state.
runtimeNotes: Uses an arbitrary admin.hooks.options function; Cloud should use serializable rules where available.
intents: make one dropdown depend on another
show states based on the selected country
